features.name: Vibe Coding with Agent Mode
features.description: AI-powered agent mode in VS Code that understands natural language requests and generates AL code. The agent reasons over project context including app.json to create table extensions, page extensions, and other scaffolding automatically.
caveats: Requires agent mode enabled in VS Code
Works best for scaffolding and boilerplate code
Difficult with complex existing applications with years of development

features.name: GPT-5 Preview Model Selection
features.description: Option to use GPT-5 preview as the underlying model for vibe coding agent, noted as one of the newest models available with flexibility to choose from other models.
features.status_evidence_quote: I like the GT5 preview right now uh because that's one of the newest models
caveats: User must select appropriate model for their use case

features.name: Automatic ID Range Resolution
features.description: Agent automatically reads app.json to determine correct ID ranges for creating new objects, mimicking what a developer would manually do when extending Business Central.

features.name: Checkpoint and Rollback System
features.description: Agent version includes checkpoints that allow developers to review changes at each stage and restore previous checkpoints if the agent goes off track, providing safety and iteration capability.

features.name: Context-Aware Code Generation
features.description: Agent accepts file references, symbols, documentation, and readme files to narrow context for more accurate code generation. Developers can specify tables, create documentation, and add markdown to guide the agent's implementation.
caveats: Requires manual context setup for complex projects

features.name: Specification-First Development Approach
features.description: Developers write formal specifications and prompts to guide agent implementation rather than focusing on code details. Specs can be saved in files and include functional requirements, guidelines, and questions to clarify requirements before coding.
caveats: Requires discipline to focus on spec rather than implementation details

features.name: Agent Question Generation
features.description: Agent can be prompted to generate clarifying questions about a solution before coding. The agent combines user prompts with Business Central knowledge to suggest 10 plus questions about tenant tables, customer linkage, and other design considerations.

features.name: Business Central Product Knowledge Integration
features.description: AI agent has training data that includes Business Central knowledge such as core tables (customer table), permission sets, permission set management, and design patterns, allowing it to reason about domain-specific architecture.
caveats: Knowledge limited to what was in training data

features.name: AI Prompt Refinement
features.description: The agent can refine simple prompts into detailed specifications by asking clarifying questions and incorporating Business Central knowledge to suggest relevant tables, fields, and integration patterns.
caveats: Requires user to review and answer clarifying questions
May need additional context for deep Business Central integration

features.name: Agent Code Generation
features.description: The agent can generate complete AL code including tables, pages, codeunits, and permissions specifications based on refined requirements, generating multiple objects simultaneously.
caveats: Output quality depends on model version
May not always follow guidelines perfectly
Sometimes produces code with errors requiring manual fixes

features.name: Iterative Vibe Coding Workflow
features.description: Vibe coding is an iterative process where developers work with the agent to incrementally build and refine code through multiple rounds of requests rather than one-off code generation.
caveats: Requires user engagement and understanding
Still requires some manual code review

features.name: AL Compiler Integration with Agents
features.description: The agent can monitor compilation feedback and diagnostics during code generation, automatically adjusting code when errors or warnings are detected.
caveats: Not all compilation signals are captured in real-time
Sometimes requires manual feeding back of error messages
Diagnostics may be delayed or incomplete

features.name: Agent Compilation Tool
features.description: Enhancement in progress to provide agents with a compile method to call directly, enabling better error detection and handling during code generation rather than relying only on post-generation diagnostics.
caveats: Still in development
Part of broader roadmap for agent tools

features.name: Agent Publish and Test Execution Tools
features.description: Future capability under development to enable agents to not only compile and publish extensions but also write and execute tests, creating a complete feedback loop for automated development.
caveats: Currently in development scope
Not yet available

features.name: Model Context Protocol Integration
features.description: MCP is an open-source standard that exposes tools and capabilities to AI agents through a discovery mechanism, allowing agents to access external resources like documentation and APIs intelligently.
caveats: Requires understanding of MCP protocol
Server availability depends on third-party implementation

features.name: Business Central Documentation MCP Server
features.description: An MCP server is available that provides agents access to the complete Business Central documentation through an API, allowing the agent to search and reference documentation when writing code.
caveats: Requires proper MCP server installation
Documentation search quality depends on API implementation

features.name: Environment Metadata MCP Server
features.description: A planned MCP server that will give access to environment metadata on the server, providing information about what symbols exist, and enabling more advanced development capabilities with metadata awareness.
caveats: Not yet implemented

features.name: Custom MCP Servers
features.description: Users can add their own MCP servers for company-specific documentation, development resources, and context. Companies can expose their own tools through MCP protocol for use in Vibe Coding.

features.name: Chat Configuration and Custom Instructions
features.description: Users can configure chat instructions, prompt files, and coding guidelines in the configuration to provide context to the AI model. Custom instructions can be added for coding standards, naming conventions, documentation requirements, and other company-specific rules.

features.name: Vibe Coding for Production
features.description: Vibe Coding is suitable for production-grade coding. It functions as a productivity tool that helps with scaffolding, tedious tasks, and enables developers to be more productive while focusing on the right things.

features.name: Multiple AI Model Support
features.description: VS Code supports multiple AI models for Vibe Coding including GPT-4, GPT-5, and Claude. Users can switch between models, try different models for different scenarios, and change models at any time during coding.
